checkpoint_selection: final episode 256 only; no best-checkpoint selection
confirmation: 12 disjoint raw-time windows, unseen DAG identities; outcomes unopened until all final checkpoints and statistics frozen

statistics.inner_replication: training seed; deterministic rules repeated only for pairing, never independent samples
statistics.test: two-sided paired sign test on per-window seed mean differences
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across all 4 metrics and all 7 primary-method comparisons

late_reward_stability.meaning: descriptive late reward stability; never proof of parameter/policy convergence

limits: modeled adapter loads and unit service steps
project-wide prior exposure not exhaustively excluded
stop_rule: No performance-based extra budget, seed exclusion, reward alteration, or confirmation retuning
